mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.5% in a month signals a tightening monetary policy, which increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where FEDFUNDS increased by more than 0.5% in a month.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate by more than 0.3% in a month indicates a strengthening labor market, which boosts consumer confidence and spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances where UNRATE decreased by more than 0.3% in a month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) over three months signals strong consumer demand, which boosts corporate revenues and earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the periods with sustained RSAFS growth.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% in a month signals a contraction in supply, which can lead to lower corporate earnings and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where INDPRO decreased by more than 1% in a month.

mechanism_narrative: When nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) increase by more than 200,000 in a month and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) decreases by more than 0.2% in the same month, it signals a robust labor market, boosting consumer confidence and spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases > 200k & UNRATE decreases > 0.2% in 1 month
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances where both conditions are met.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) increase by more than 5% in a month and real GDP (GDPC1) grows by more than 0.5% quarter-over-quarter, it indicates strong demand, which boosts corporate revenues and earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the instances where both conditions are met.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) by more than 2% over three months signals inflationary pressure, which can lead to monetary tightening and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the periods with sustained CPIAUCSL growth.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) increases by more than 1% in a month and the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is below 1%, it signals a favorable environment for corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the instances where both conditions are met.
